faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Why publishers switch from generic ebook generators to PublishGuard.

ban_risk.question: How is PublishGuard different from getebook.ai or BookBud?
ban_risk.answer: Generic generators stop at exporting AI prose. PublishGuard integrates a 26-rule KDP compliance firewall (blocking clinical words, promo codes, external eBook hyperlinks, and low-content box layouts), live title collision checks, and exact KDP spine-width wrap cover engineering.

word_count.question: Why does PublishGuard target 18,000+ words instead of short booklets?
word_count.answer: Amazon KDP aggressively flags thin booklets under 10,000 words as "Disappointing Customer Experience" (Thin Content). Our rolling-memory pipeline structures 12 deep sections reaching 18,000–22,000 words for solid 100-page paperback authority.

ownership.question: Do I own 100% of the commercial rights and royalties?
ownership.answer: Yes. You retain 100% copyright, publishing rights, and Amazon KDP royalties. PublishGuard never embeds ads, hidden publisher imprints, or affiliate watermarks inside your files.

kdp_setup.question: Does it help me fill out the Amazon KDP dashboard?
kdp_setup.answer: Every generated bundle includes a copy-ready KDP Metadata Checklist mapped strictly to Amazon's 31 official top-level categories, 7 ≤50-char backend keywords, and character-safe non-formulaic subtitles.

refund.question: What happens if a generation job fails?
refund.answer: Our credit ledger is atomic: if a worker fails before delivering your verified EPUB/PDF bundle, 100% of deducted credits are automatically revoked back to your balance.
